title: Polynomial work bound for the construction
statement: As the scale of the small-bias input tends to infinity, the deterministic construction work is $O((\text{scale}+1)^8)$. The inputs have positive dimension, positive accuracy numerator, and twice the numerator at most the denominator.
hypotheses_covered: Twice the accuracy numerator is at most its denominator
Asymptotic parameter is the input scale tending to infinity
